method: Native personality held fixed for own full draft; unchanged native formulas, standard draft-fit plan selection and default items. Other side uses Standard weighted or Standard top-ranked policy. Same per-turn/opening/profile-generation random streams within each pair; responding opponents and role-variant sets can differ. Sixteen held-out strategy/role/default-purchase-order cases per completed draft. Severe loss: losing case with signed gold below -20000. Related deterministic scenarios, not independent PvP matches; native simulator seed unmodified. No production integration.
